posts.title: You’re using AI wrong
posts.description: Intentionally bait title ;) You’re not using it wrong, but you need to stop thinking rigidly about AI use. You might be all in on one harness. Don’t be. Try other harnesses, see what they do differently. See how they improve (or break) your workflow. You might be using a single agent at a time. Don’t. Try using sub-agents. posts.title: Freedom of the Last Minute
posts.description: Leaving logistical plans until the last minute leaves you with fewer decisions to make, fewer options to compare, and more importantly, more time to enjoy yourself. If you accept that the future is in flux, and things won’t always your way, you’ll end up stressing less, and going with the flow.
